**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant on Customer (or on Vendor). Section 12.3 goes further and affirmatively records that nothing restricts Customer from "hiring any person who responds to general recruitment" and that Customer "has made no ... no-hire commitment." That satisfies our preferred position outright, so no redline is proposed. Section 12.4 is a Vendor-side restriction that benefits us and is not flagged.
